Reviewed: PR #30940 · issue → #31470

the same omitted `required` on a sole `master_detail` is a REQUIRED master through `ObjectSchema.create()` and an OPTIONAL master through the raw parse / `defineStack`; the semantic entry and changeset prose name only the first reading [should-fix]

Evidence: diff controlled-by-parent-master.ts:881-893 — `controlledByParentMasterOf` reads `required === false`, and the object refinement runs on the parsed map where an omitted `required` defaults to `false` (object.zod.ts docblock, diff :1170-1175). Pinned by the hunk's own tests: `ObjectSchema.safeParse` admits the omission as `{field:'order', optional:true}` while `create()` yields `optional:false` (diff controlled-by-parent-master.test.ts:674-688); `defineStack` with an omitted `required` now returns `required: false` where it previously threw (main packages/spec/src/conversions/cbp-master-detail-required-defaulted.test.ts:117-129). The runtime acts on that reading: plugin-security opens the owner arm on `rel.optional` (security-plugin-cbp-relation.ts:170-172, security-plugin-cbp-write-gate.ts:529). The semantic entry says an omitted `required` "keeps meaning required through `ObjectSchema.create()` and on stored rows" (main migrations/entries/semantic/18.cbp-optional-master-admitted.ts:39-41, 63) and never names the `defineStack`/raw-parse door; only `os lint` (`relationship/master-detail-required`, packages/lint/src/data-model-rules.ts:433) reports it. Otherwise sound: `controlledByParentMasterOf` live in plugin-security, objectql, lint, cli, verify, ui; spec minor, `Clause-②: yes (widening)`, `Metadata-protocol: added`; rationale order 119 present.

## Done · post-hoc spec review of 29 PRs · 2026-11-08T11:02Z

Every PR on this card has one `Reviewed: PR #N · …` line above (29 of 29). Tier A (spec contract changes) was read by Fable reviewers against `main` at `3c380253e`; Tier B and C were read by the seat.

**Result: 26 OK, 3 with an issue, each filed as its own card.**

| PR | Finding | Card |
|---|---|---|
| #30940 | An omitted `required` on the sole `master_detail` means required through `create()` but optional through raw parse / `defineStack`, so plugin-security opens the owner arm on the second door. Should-fix; seat suggests p1. | #31470 |
| #31037 | The changeset `cloud-3656-spec-delete-package-tool-name.md` declares `Clause-②: no` / patch for a widening of the platform tool-name set. Must-fix before the next release. | #31471 |
